“Sway” could refer to a few different apps. Which one do you mean?

- Microsoft Sway (most common): A browser-based presentation/storytelling tool in Microsoft 365 for making interactive reports, newsletters, and web pages you share via a link. It auto-formats content and supports collaboration.
- Sway Medical: A health app used by clinicians/athletes to assess balance and reaction time using a phone’s motion sensors.
- Something else (e.g., the Linux “sway” window manager isn’t an app but a desktop compositor).

If you tell me which Sway you’re asking about, I can give details or how-to steps.
